about: The Movie Database (TMDB), a community database of movies, TV shows and people. This CLI scrapes the public, logged-out website for trending and popular titles, search, discover and preset listings, movie, TV, season, person and collection details, cast, reviews and keyword/genre listings.

commands.summary: Trending movies and TV shows today or this week (home page scroller, 20 items)
Home page 'What's Popular' titles by channel (streaming, on TV, in theatres)
Keyword search on TMDB, filtered to one result type (movie, tv, person, collection, keyword, company, network)
Discover movies with filters (genres, keywords, rating, vote count, dates, language, runtime) and sort order, paginated

params.name: with_genres
params.description: Comma-separated TMDB genre ids, e.g. 878 (Science Fiction), 28 (Action)

params.name: release_date_gte
params.description: Earliest release date, ISO date e.g. 2000-01-01

params.name: release_date_lte
params.description: Latest release date, ISO date e.g. 2027-04-18

params.name: with_original_language
params.description: ISO 639-1 original language, e.g. en, ja, hi

params.name: discover_preset
params.description: Optional listing preset the site uses (e.g. top-rated); leave empty for plain discover

commands.summary: Preset movie listings: top rated, now playing, upcoming (use discover-movies with sort_by=popularity.desc for popular)
Preset TV listings: shows airing today or currently on the air
Movie details: title, year, certification, US release date, genres, runtime, tagline, overview, director, user score

params.name: id
params.description: TMDB movie id, optionally with slug (e.g. 11 or 11-star-wars), as found in result urls

commands.summary: Full cast and crew of a movie (name, character or job, person url)

params.name: id
params.description: TMDB movie id, optionally with slug, e.g. 11-star-wars

commands.summary: User reviews of a movie (author/heading, teaser text, link)

params.name: id
params.description: TMDB movie id, optionally with slug, e.g. 11-star-wars

commands.summary: TV series details: name, first-air year, certification, genres, overview, creator, user score, latest season

params.name: id
params.description: TMDB TV id, optionally with slug, e.g. 4194-star-wars-the-clone-wars

commands.summary: Episodes of one TV season (number, title, air date, runtime, overview)

params.name: id
params.description: TMDB TV id, optionally with slug

commands.summary: Daily popularity-rank change chart for a TV show (last 7 days)

params.name: id
params.description: TMDB TV id with slug, e.g. 4194-star-wars-the-clone-wars

commands.summary: Person details: name, biography, personal info (known for, birthday, birthplace), aliases, top known-for title

params.name: id
params.description: TMDB person id, optionally with slug, e.g. 2-mark-hamill

commands.summary: Popular people on TMDB with their best-known titles, paginated
Cast and crew credits across a movie collection/franchise (name, roles, person url)

params.name: id
params.description: TMDB collection id, optionally with slug, e.g. 10-star-wars-collection

commands.summary: Movies tagged with a keyword (e.g. space opera), paginated

params.name: id
params.description: Keyword id with slug, e.g. 161176-space-opera (find via search --type keyword)
